items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: So Billy Shaw, who was Milt's father, he had to fly over

ctx.x: All the members of the band on the same bus?

Yeah, uh huh, sure. We did all right and we went to Europe, the first jazz band from America after the war. That was a tremendous... we got up into...where were we at?...the European agent run off with the money and we were stuck in the Metropole Hotel in (Belgium)...this European agent run off with the money and we were stuck in the hotel; we were stranded. So Billy Shaw, who was Milt's father, he had to fly over and I don't know what all happened but anyway we got out of there...hahahaha. But Brussels is more…
